execution_boundaries: Build a fresh environment dictionary for outer E2E and fixture children; reject every unapproved GATE_E2E_* flag, including catalog scale even with empty/zero values.
HOME/TMP/XDG/npm caches, copied browser cache, all test output/JSON/HTML/trace/screenshots and browser temporary files are scoped to the registered run directory.
Generated test/config files have an explicit ESM boundary, preserve the source assertions and timeouts, and enumerate only the four target desktops plus one permission group.

The fixture cannot import Gate until a separate per-run approval marker exists. A run-owned wrapper replaces only serve module TemporaryDirectory lifetime, holding the application DB until owned reap and listener checks.

PID identity/start-time, zombies, reuse and unreadable identity are fail-closed. Original-service PID is never signalled. Only the exact validated root may be removed after reaping and both listeners close.
On uncertain cleanup, the owned root remains private; its DB/password/session/policy/draft state must be treated as still present until verified destruction.
Only product-related sanitized receipts are exported. Detailed runtime identities, environment, namespace, database, cookies, keys and traces remain private.
